instructions:
You advise an operational agent that must answer the principal's need with live data. Propose
(1) public data APIs that need no key and return JSON relevant to the questions -- give exact GET URLs with every
parameter filled in from the resolved subjects (coordinates, time zone, identifiers), and the JSON paths you expect
in the answer; and (2) pages of existing services people already use that answer the question directly (give the
exact page URL for this subject, plus the link texts a person would click from the site's home page to reach it,
in case the URL has moved). Each proposal is fetched and checked; propose only what you are confident exists.
Prefer few, reliable sources. If nothing beyond what was already observed is relevant, return empty lists.

need.sentence: I want to know, at a glance, how many real people are actually using LindyBooks.

exclude: internal staff, developers and test/demo accounts
duplicate accounts or devices of the same person where detectable
anonymous one-off page loads with no real engagement
questions.quantity: Distinct individual humans who performed at least one meaningful use action (e.g. opened and engaged with the product beyond signing up or loading a page) in the window; each person counted once across devices/accounts where identifiable
questions.question: How many distinct real human people have actually used LindyBooks recently?
questions.population: Real human end users of LindyBooks who engaged in meaningful use during the window

questions.quantity: Total registered accounts, for context against active real people
questions.question: How does the count of actively-using real people compare to total registered accounts?

deliverable.why: 'At a glance' implies a view readable in seconds that stays current, showing one headline number of real active people.

url.description: full GET URL, parameters filled in

expected_fields.description: dotted JSON paths, list indexes as numbers

link_texts.description: visible link texts a person would click, from the site's home page to this page, in the site's language
